summary: Eval results shows an eval suite's latest run case by case. A bar with one segment per case fills as the cases run, the pass count is compared with the run before, and a filter narrows the list to the failed cases. A failed case opens to show what was expected, what came back and where the answer comes from, with a fix that runs it again.
use: When an agent's output is checked by a set of evals and people need to see which ones failed, not just a score.
When a change to a prompt, a model or the agent's work should be compared with the run before, to catch a regression.
When a failure needs its evidence, expected against what came back, to be fixed.
When the suite is long and people only want the failures.
features: `cases` is the suite. Each case has a `name`, a `status` of `queued`, `running`, `pass` or `fail`, and a `time` shown once it has a result.
The bar has one segment per case: grey while queued, pulsing while running, green for a pass and red for a fail.

The count reads "Running 3 of 8" while `running`, then "7 of 8 passed". With `previousPassed`, a tag compares the settled run with the one before, like "1 fewer than the last run", or reads All passing.
`onRun` adds a filled run button, labelled by `runLabel`; it spins while `running`.
All and Failed switch the list, with the count on each; the cases that don't match fold away. With no failures, Failed says "No failed cases".
A failed case is red-tinted and opens to show `expected`, `got` in red and `source`, with an optional white `fix` button, like Use $24 and rerun.
a11y: The cases form a list labelled "Cases". A failed case is a button with `aria-expanded`, and its details fold away inert when it's shut.
All and Failed are a labelled group of toggle buttons with `aria-pressed`.
The pass count is announced politely as it changes.
The bar is decoration; the count says the same in words.

faq.a: No. `onRun` tells you to start. Set each case's `status` as your eval runner reports it, and `running` for the whole run.

faq.q: What does the fix button do?
faq.a: Whatever you pass as its `onClick`. In the demo it changes the copy to the billing table's price and runs that one case again.

faq.q: Can it show scores instead of pass and fail?
faq.a: Not yet. Each case passes or fails; put a score in its `name` or `time` if you need one there.

faq.q: How does it compare with the last run?
faq.a: By the number that passed. Pass `previousPassed` from your last run, and the tag appears once every case has a result.
